description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format big-box retail store in Courtenay offering a full grocery section alongside electronics, clothing, toys, and household goods. As one of the largest retail destinations on the mid-Island, it provides a one-stop resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley. The store (number 3163) is located on Cliffe Avenue, a major commercial corridor in Courtenay.
